answer.rationale: The low-cost vendor is the only option currently meeting the mandated 18% reduction, while the incumbent has refused repricing. Verify its prior onboarding and invoicing performance, and the evidence on supply resilience. Switch as a guarded test because the contract expires in 14 days and the line is already at 94% of committed volume, creating meaningful delivery and migration risk. A second-source strategy would reduce concentration risk but may not deliver the required savings in this single decision cycle.
